The '''Minecart''' is a method of travel unlocked after completing the [[Bundles#Boiler Room|Boiler Room Bundles]] or by purchasing "Minecarts" from the [[Joja Community Development Form]] at [[JojaMart]] for {{Price|15000}}. They are available for travel the next day.

Minecarts allow the player to travel between four destinations throughout Stardew Valley.
